gloss: the distant future; the far future

definitions.gloss: the distant future; the far future
definitions.explanation: A point in time far ahead from now. Often contrasted with {近|ちか}い{将来|しょうらい} (the near future).

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}い{将来|しょうらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't know about the distant future.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}い{将来|しょうらい}、⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: In the distant future, we may live in space.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠|とお}い{将来|しょうらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}して→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: That's a matter for the distant future; there's no point worrying about it now.

notes:
Combination of the i-adjective ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧ (far) and ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧ (future).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠|とお}い{将来|しょうらい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見据|みす}える→見据える：14131_misueru⟧: to look ahead to the distant future
- {遠|とお}い{将来|しょうらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧: a dream for the far future

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧: the near future — the direct antonym
- ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧: the future (in general) — the base noun
